rules: Use tracking-tight for all headings larger than text-2xl.
Never use bold for large headings, use font-medium or font-semibold for Manrope to keep it clean.
Numbers in tables and financial summaries MUST use 'tabular-nums' utility class.
Hierarchy Gap Rule: Ensure contrast in font sizes. H1 should be text-3xl to text-4xl max for dashboards.
Never use pure black #000000. Use text-slate-900 (#0F172A) for max contrast.
Backgrounds for app layout should be slate-50 to make white cards pop.
Use colors to denote financial status (green for paid/income, red for overdue/expense, amber for pending/tax).

layouts.dashboard: High density grid for metrics. Top row: 4 columns for summary stats. Second row: Main chart (col-span-3) + Recent activity feed (col-span-1).
layouts.forms: Use clean, stacked inputs. Use Shadcn Form components. Max width for forms should be max-w-2xl for better readability. Never full width.
layouts.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar. White background, 1px right border. Active state should have a subtle slate-100 background and primary color text/icon.
layouts.data_tables: Dense rows, no alternating background colors. 1px bottom border per row. Use right-alignment for all monetary columns.
layouts.document_scan_flow: Two-pane layout. Left pane: PDF/Image preview (sticky). Right pane: Extracted data form for review and editing.

components.cards: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm. No heavy drop shadows.
components.buttons: rounded-lg. Primary button: bg-[#0052FF] text-white hover:bg-[#0040CC]. Secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50.
components.badges: rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium. Use subtle background with darker text (e.g., bg-green-100 text-green-800 for paid invoices).

rules: Use extremely subtle transitions. duration-200 ease-in-out for hover states.
No bouncy or dramatic entrance animations. This is a professional financial tool.
Use skeleton loaders for data fetching, not spinners.
All monetary values must have proper aria-labels if abbreviated.
Use proper contrast ratios for all muted text (slate-500 is minimum for white bg).
Include data-testid on all interactive elements for testing.

visual_enhancers.empty_states: Use wide spacing (p-12), a dashed border (border-dashed border-2 border-slate-200), and a single lucide-react icon (size 48, text-slate-400) centered with a clear CTA.
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react. Stroke width 1.5 for a professional, clean look.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid glassmorphism for this financial dashboard. Stick to crisp solid surfaces (surface #FFFFFF) with 1px borders.

instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign the UI to match top-tier SaaS like Holded or Quaderno. Keep it extremely clean, avoiding AI-slop gradients or dark themes. It must look like a high-end Spanish invoicing product.
Use Manrope for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text. Enforce 'tabular-nums' for all numbers and tables.
Do NOT break any existing functionality. The app must continue to work as before, just with a new coat of professional paint.
Ensure the scanning/OCR UI feels like a professional two-pane review screen (preview on left, form on right).
Replace generic cards with crisp, border-driven designs (rounded-lg, border-slate-200, shadow-sm). Do not use heavy shadows.
Ensure all monetary amounts are right-aligned in tables.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons and interactive elements.
The project uses .js/.jsx files (not .tsx). Do not write TypeScript syntax.
Do not use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use generous spacing (2-3x more than standard). Cramped designs look cheap.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
Use sonner for toasts (located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js if it exists, or create it).
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Never use placeholder URLs for images.
